svg.title: The detour on Pennsylvania Avenue
svg.desc: Editorial illustration for Nov. 21, 2026. At night on Pennsylvania Avenue, the floodlit Capitol dome glows at the far end of the road, but a towering blank sheet with a red seal, a symbol of President Trump's new executive order, stands across the avenue. A line of generic federal contractors, hard-hat workers and office staff with folders and boxes, turns aside at the sheet and queues toward the White House's north portico and gate. The order directs contractors to check with the White House before answering Congress.
